predecessors.name: Roman Empire
predecessors.text: the province of Judaea and Galilee, cleared of Roman authority after Gallus's defeat

successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: Judaea, which 'later became a directly ruled province' (the roman-empire dossier's note)

ledger.x: 66: the Jewish provisional government is set up in Jerusalem.
spring 68: Vespasian subdues the settlements on the road to Jerusalem.

wars.name: First Jewish-Roman War
wars.outcome: Roman victory: Vespasian's Galilee campaign in 67, the road to Jerusalem in 68, the siege of Jerusalem from 13 April to 8 September 70 and the Temple destroyed; Masada fell in 73/74.

certainty.note: The districts are listed by name; no page gives a boundary.
